'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Wayne Cullen DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Wayne Cullen]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations]]
* '''Username:''' KissmyWookiee
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
